children: CO2 Energy Transition's net income declined year over year, as lower interest earned on Trust Account investments more than offset higher operating costs and lower income tax provision. The company reported no operating revenues and continues to pursue a business combination.
: A non-binding letter of intent expired after the parties did not extend the September 14 deadline; discussions with that party and other opportunities continue.
: Stockholders approved up to 11 monthly extensions through June 22, 2027; the company had extended through November 22, 2026 as of the filing.
: Holders redeemed 5,869,285 shares in July, about 85% of public shares, leaving 1,030,715 public shares outstanding.
